method: Read frozen rows, selections, orders and maps; reconstruct atomic graph with adjacency traversal; score saved finite 96-slot weights using signed differences and integer half-credit; recompute tie RNG, fixed-family strata, slot collisions and canonical-world group-pair conflicts; recompute all seed-level summary statistics. No SGD or generator execution.
limitations: Saved weights were evaluated, not retrained or independently reproduced by optimization.
Online training-loss curves checked only for finite values, planned checkpoints and noncollapsed update counts; losses not recalculated by training.
Two world rows repeat one unordered pair; 10 seeds are the reporting units.
This audit verifies evidence consistency, not real-knowledge validity or learned grouping.
publication_transform: Selected metadata and coverage from the full local audit. Redundant aggregate/per-receipt result arrays are omitted; all 140 cells were checked.
recomputation_boundary: The independent audit scored local saved weights against local frozen inputs. Those weight-bearing receipts and datasets are not distributed. Public summaries and hashes alone cannot repeat that historical audit.
